name: Paracetamol 500mg Tablets
description: Paracetamol is a widely used pain reliever and fever reducer. It effectively treats mild to moderate pain such as headaches, muscle aches, and reduces fever. Contains 500mg of paracetamol per tablet.
usage_instructions: Adults and children over 12 years: Take 1-2 tablets every 4-6 hours as needed. Do not exceed 8 tablets in 24 hours.
warnings: Do not exceed recommended dose. Avoid if you have liver disease. May interact with alcohol and other medications containing paracetamol.

name: Ibuprofen 200mg Tablets
description: Ibuprofen is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and lower fever. Key ingredient is ibuprofen 200mg per tablet, ideal for headaches, dental pain, and muscle aches.
usage_instructions: Adults and children over 12 years: Take 1-2 tablets every 6-8 hours with food. Do not exceed 6 tablets in 24 hours.
warnings: Avoid if you have stomach ulcers, kidney problems, or heart disease. May cause stomach upset or bleeding. Consult doctor if on blood thinners.

name: Vitamin C 500mg Tablets
description: Vitamin C is an antioxidant that supports immune function and skin health. Each tablet contains 500mg of ascorbic acid, helping to reduce the duration of colds and promote wound healing.
usage_instructions: Adults: Take 1 tablet daily with water, preferably with food.
warnings: High doses may cause stomach upset or kidney stones. Consult a doctor if pregnant or breastfeeding.

name: Zinc Lozenges 25mg
description: Zinc lozenges help reduce the severity and duration of cold symptoms. Each lozenge contains 25mg of zinc gluconate, which supports immune defense and soothes sore throat.
usage_instructions: Dissolve 1 lozenge slowly in the mouth every 2-3 hours during cold symptoms. Do not exceed 6 lozenges daily.
warnings: Do not use for more than 7 days. Excess zinc can cause nausea or copper deficiency. Avoid if allergic to zinc.

name: Hydrocortisone 1% Cream
description: Hydrocortisone cream is a mild corticosteroid used to relieve itching, redness, and inflammation from eczema, insect bites, and allergic reactions. Contains 1% hydrocortisone acetate.
usage_instructions: Apply a thin layer to affected area 1-2 times daily. Do not use on broken skin or face for prolonged periods.
warnings: Avoid use in children under 2 years. Prolonged use may cause skin thinning. Do not use with other corticosteroids without medical advice.

name: Loperamide 2mg Capsules
description: Loperamide is an anti-diarrheal medication that slows gut movement to reduce diarrhea. Each capsule contains 2mg of loperamide hydrochloride, effective for acute, non-infectious diarrhea.
usage_instructions: Adults: Take 2 capsules after first loose stool, then 1 capsule after each subsequent loose stool. Do not exceed 8 capsules in 24 hours.
warnings: Avoid if diarrhea is caused by bacterial infection or with blood/mucus in stools. Not for children under 12. Consult doctor if pregnant.

name: Antihistamine Cetirizine 10mg
description: Cetirizine is a non-drowsy antihistamine used to relieve hay fever, allergic rhinitis, and urticaria. Each tablet contains 10mg cetirizine hydrochloride, providing 24-hour allergy symptom relief.
usage_instructions: Adults and children over 6 years: Take 1 tablet once daily with or without food.
warnings: May cause drowsiness in some people. Avoid alcohol while taking this medication. Consult doctor if breastfeeding or pregnant.

name: Saline Nasal Spray
description: Saline nasal spray helps to moisturize nasal passages, relieve congestion, and clear mucus. Contains sterile isotonic saline solution safe for all ages.
usage_instructions: Spray 1-2 times into each nostril as needed, up to 4 times daily.
warnings: For external nasal use only. Avoid contamination of the nozzle. Consult doctor if symptoms persist more than 7 days.

name: Aloe Vera Gel 100ml
description: Pure Aloe Vera gel soothes and moisturizes skin, aiding in healing minor burns, sunburns, and skin irritations. Contains 99% natural aloe vera extract.
usage_instructions: Apply gently to affected skin areas as needed. Suitable for daily use.
warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Discontinue if irritation occurs.

name: Diphenhydramine 25mg Capsules
description: Diphenhydramine is an antihistamine with sedative properties used for short-term treatment of insomnia. Each capsule contains 25mg of diphenhydramine hydrochloride.
usage_instructions: Adults: Take 1 capsule 30 minutes before bedtime. Do not exceed recommended dose.
warnings: May cause drowsiness, dry mouth, and dizziness. Avoid alcohol. Not recommended for elderly or children under 12.

name: Antiseptic Wound Spray
description: Antiseptic spray containing chlorhexidine gluconate for cleaning and disinfecting minor cuts, wounds, and abrasions. Helps prevent infection and promotes healing.
usage_instructions: Spray directly onto wound after cleaning. Use 1-3 times daily until healed.
warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes. Discontinue if irritation occurs.

name: Magnesium Citrate 150mg Tablets
description: Magnesium citrate supplements support muscle and nerve function and help prevent magnesium deficiency. Each tablet contains 150mg elemental magnesium.
usage_instructions: Adults: Take 1 tablet daily with food.
warnings: High doses may cause diarrhea. Consult doctor if pregnant, breastfeeding, or taking other medications.

name: Calamine Lotion 120ml
description: Calamine lotion soothes itching and irritation caused by insect bites, poison ivy, and minor skin irritations. Contains calamine and zinc oxide for cooling relief.
usage_instructions: Apply gently to affected skin up to 3 times daily.
warnings: For external use only. Avoid broken skin and eyes. Discontinue if rash worsens.

name: Simethicone 80mg Tablets
description: Simethicone relieves symptoms of gas and bloating by breaking up gas bubbles in the gut. Each tablet contains 80mg of simethicone.
usage_instructions: Adults: Take 1-2 tablets after meals and at bedtime as needed. Do not exceed 8 tablets daily.
warnings: Safe for most users. Consult a doctor if symptoms persist or worsen.

name: Naproxen 250mg Tablets
description: Naproxen is a NSAID used to relieve inflammation, pain, and stiffness from conditions like arthritis or muscle injuries. Each tablet contains 250mg naproxen sodium.
usage_instructions: Adults: Take 1 tablet every 8-12 hours with food. Do not exceed 3 tablets in 24 hours.
warnings: Avoid if you have stomach ulcers, kidney or heart disease. May cause stomach upset, bleeding, or dizziness. Consult doctor if taking blood thinners.

name: Melatonin 3mg Tablets
description: Melatonin is a natural hormone that regulates sleep-wake cycles. This supplement contains 3mg melatonin, used to treat jet lag or short-term insomnia.
usage_instructions: Take 1 tablet 30 minutes before bedtime. Use short-term only unless advised by a doctor.
warnings: May cause drowsiness and dizziness. Avoid alcohol and operating machinery. Consult doctor if pregnant or breastfeeding.

name: Guaifenesin 200mg Syrup
description: Guaifenesin is an expectorant that helps loosen mucus in the chest, making coughs more productive. Each 5ml contains 200mg guaifenesin.
usage_instructions: Adults: Take 10-20ml every 4 hours. Do not exceed 120ml in 24 hours.
warnings: Do not use for persistent coughs associated with smoking or asthma. Consult doctor if pregnant or breastfeeding.

name: Aspirin 100mg Low Dose
description: Low dose aspirin is used to reduce blood clot risk and relieve mild pain. Each tablet contains 100mg acetylsalicylic acid.
usage_instructions: Take 1 tablet daily or as prescribed by your doctor.
warnings: Not for use in children under 16. Avoid if allergic to NSAIDs or with bleeding disorders. Consult doctor before use.

name: Vitamin D3 1000 IU Capsules
description: Vitamin D3 supports bone, teeth, and immune health. Each capsule contains 1000 IU (25 mcg) of cholecalciferol.
usage_instructions: Take 1 capsule daily with food.
warnings: Excessive intake may cause toxicity. Consult doctor if pregnant, breastfeeding, or on other medications.

name: Menthol Chest Rub 50g
description: Menthol chest rub provides soothing relief from chest congestion and cough. Contains menthol, eucalyptus oil, and camphor.
usage_instructions: Apply a small amount to chest and throat up to 3 times daily. Avoid applying near eyes or broken skin.
warnings: For external use only. Do not use on children under 2 years. Discontinue if irritation occurs.

name: Calcium Carbonate 600mg Tablets
description: Calcium carbonate supplements support bone health and prevent osteoporosis. Each tablet contains 600mg elemental calcium.
usage_instructions: Adults: Take 1 tablet twice daily with food.
warnings: Do not exceed recommended dose. May cause constipation. Consult doctor if kidney disease or taking other medications.

name: Hydroxyzine 25mg Tablets
description: Hydroxyzine is an antihistamine used to treat severe allergies, anxiety, and nausea. Contains 25mg hydroxyzine hydrochloride per tablet.
usage_instructions: Take as prescribed by your doctor. Usually 1 tablet 2-4 times daily.
warnings: May cause drowsiness and dry mouth. Avoid alcohol and driving. Not for use in pregnancy unless directed by a doctor.

name: Activated Charcoal Tablets 250mg
description: Activated charcoal helps relieve gas, bloating, and poisoning by adsorbing toxins in the gut. Each tablet contains 250mg activated charcoal.
usage_instructions: Adults: Take 2-4 tablets after meals or as needed.
warnings: Do not use with other oral medications within 2 hours. Not for long-term use. Consult doctor if pregnant or breastfeeding.

name: Hydrogen Peroxide 3% Solution
description: Hydrogen peroxide 3% is an antiseptic used for cleaning wounds and preventing infection. It foams upon contact with blood to help remove debris.
usage_instructions: Apply to wound with cotton swab or gauze. Use once or twice daily as needed.
warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Do not use on deep wounds or punctures.

name: Oxymetazoline Nasal Spray 0.05%
description: Oxymetazoline is a nasal decongestant that shrinks swollen nasal membranes to relieve congestion. Contains 0.05% oxymetazoline hydrochloride.
usage_instructions: Spray 1-2 times into each nostril every 12 hours. Do not exceed 2 doses in 24 hours or use for more than 3 days.
warnings: Prolonged use may cause rebound congestion. Avoid if allergic to sympathomimetics.

name: Vitamin B12 1000mcg Tablets
description: Vitamin B12 supports nerve function and red blood cell production. Each tablet contains 1000mcg cyanocobalamin.
usage_instructions: Take 1 tablet daily or as directed by a healthcare professional.
warnings: Generally safe but consult doctor if pregnant or breastfeeding.

name: Antacid Chewable Tablets
description: Antacid tablets neutralize stomach acid to relieve heartburn and indigestion. Contains calcium carbonate and magnesium hydroxide.
usage_instructions: Chew 1-2 tablets as symptoms occur, up to 8 tablets daily.
warnings: Do not exceed recommended dose. Consult doctor if taking other medications or if symptoms persist.

name: Antibiotic Cream (Neomycin, Bacitracin)
description: Topical antibiotic cream containing neomycin and bacitracin to prevent infection in minor cuts, burns, and abrasions.
usage_instructions: Apply a thin layer to the affected area 1-3 times daily.
warnings: For external use only. Avoid use if allergic to neomycin or bacitracin. Discontinue if rash occurs.

name: Diphenhydramine Allergy Relief Liquid
description: Liquid diphenhydramine provides fast relief from allergic reactions such as hives, itching, and hay fever. Contains 12.5mg diphenhydramine per 5ml.
usage_instructions: Adults and children over 12: Take 10-20ml every 4-6 hours. Do not exceed 120ml in 24 hours.
warnings: May cause drowsiness. Avoid alcohol. Do not use in children under 12 without doctor advice.

name: Lidocaine 5% Cream
description: Lidocaine cream provides local anesthesia to relieve pain and itching from insect bites, sunburn, and minor skin irritations. Contains 5% lidocaine hydrochloride.
usage_instructions: Apply a thin layer to affected area up to 3 times daily.
warnings: For external use only. Avoid broken skin and eyes. Do not use on large areas or under occlusive dressings.

name: Melaleuca Oil (Tea Tree Oil) 15ml
description: Natural tea tree oil with antimicrobial properties used to treat acne, fungal infections, and minor skin irritations.
usage_instructions: Dilute with carrier oil and apply to affected area once or twice daily.
warnings: For external use only. Do not apply undiluted to skin. Avoid eyes. Discontinue if irritation occurs.

name: Nasal Decongestant Tablets (Pseudoephedrine) 60mg
description: Pseudoephedrine tablets relieve nasal congestion due to colds and allergies by constricting blood vessels in the nasal passages.
usage_instructions: Adults: Take 1 tablet every 4-6 hours. Do not exceed 4 tablets in 24 hours.
warnings: Avoid if you have hypertension, heart disease, or glaucoma. May cause insomnia or nervousness.

name: Vitamin E Oil 50ml
description: Vitamin E oil is an antioxidant that helps moisturize skin, reduce scars, and protect against UV damage.
usage_instructions: Apply a few drops to skin and massage gently. Use daily for best results.
warnings: For external use only. Avoid eyes. Discontinue if irritation occurs.

name: Oral Rehydration Salts
description: Oral rehydration salts (ORS) help restore fluids and electrolytes lost during diarrhea or vomiting. Contains glucose, sodium, potassium, and citrate.
usage_instructions: Dissolve one sachet in 200ml water and drink as needed.
warnings: Do not use with undiluted water. Consult doctor if symptoms persist or worsen.

name: Benzocaine 20% Oral Gel
description: Benzocaine oral gel provides temporary relief from toothache, sore gums, and mouth ulcers. Contains 20% benzocaine topical anesthetic.
usage_instructions: Apply a small amount to affected area up to 4 times daily.
warnings: Do not swallow gel. Avoid use in children under 2 years. Discontinue if allergic reaction occurs.

name: Eucalyptus Oil 30ml
description: Eucalyptus oil is used to relieve nasal congestion and muscle pain. Contains natural eucalyptus leaf oil with expectorant properties.
usage_instructions: Dilute before topical use or add a few drops to a diffuser. Do not ingest.
warnings: For external use only. Avoid eyes and broken skin. Not for children under 6 years.

name: Calcium Magnesium Zinc Tablets
description: Combination supplement supporting bone health and immune function. Contains calcium 300mg, magnesium 150mg, and zinc 15mg per tablet.
usage_instructions: Take 1 tablet daily with food.
warnings: Do not exceed recommended dose. Consult doctor if pregnant, breastfeeding, or on medication.

name: Hydrocolloid Blister Plasters
description: Hydrocolloid plasters protect and promote healing of blisters by maintaining a moist environment. Ideal for foot blisters and minor skin injuries.
usage_instructions: Clean and dry affected area. Apply plaster and change every 3-5 days or when loose.
warnings: For external use only. Discontinue if irritation or infection occurs.

name: Dextromethorphan 15mg Cough Syrup
description: Dextromethorphan suppresses dry cough by acting on the cough center in the brain. Each 5ml contains 15mg dextromethorphan hydrobromide.
usage_instructions: Adults and children over 12: Take 10ml every 4-6 hours. Do not exceed 60ml in 24 hours.
warnings: Do not use with MAO inhibitors or within 14 days of stopping them. May cause dizziness or nausea.

name: Calcium Folinate 15mg Tablets
description: Calcium folinate is a form of folic acid used to treat folate deficiency and reduce side effects of certain chemotherapy drugs.
usage_instructions: Use only as prescribed by your healthcare provider.
warnings: Not for self-medication. Consult your doctor before use.
